user.title: Connect an OrbitDMD panel
user.description: Address of the panel (as in your browser, e.g. orbitdmd.local or 192.168.1.50) and the password of its web page.

zeroconf_confirm.title: OrbitDMD panel found
zeroconf_confirm.description: The panel “{name}” was found on the network ({host}). Enter the password of its web page to connect it.

reauth_confirm.description: The panel refused the password: enter the current password of its web page.

error.cannot_connect: Panel unreachable: check the address and that it is switched on.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Panel unreachable: check the address and that it is switched on.
abort.not_orbitdmd: This device is not an OrbitDMD panel.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a text and/or a GIF on the panel right away, over the GIFs.

message.name: Text
message.description: Text to scroll (200 bytes at most).

gif.name: GIF
gif.description: GIF played before the text: Category/name.gif

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Number of passes of the GIF and the text (1 to 10).

font.name: Font
font.description: Pixel or a font file of the panel.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Small animated GIF left of the text: Icones/name.gif (the text scrolls beside it).

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: 2: the text on two lines, one under the other (effects Up, Down, Letter by letter, Rain, Fade).

panel_too_old.title: Update the OrbitDMD panel “{name}”
panel_too_old.description: The panel “{name}” runs program {version}. The integration needs version {minimum} or later to show alerts. Download the latest program (link below), then install it from the panel's web page: System → New program.

panel_too_old.message: The panel “{name}” runs program {version}: install version {minimum} or later (panel web page → System → New program).

no_panel.message: No OrbitDMD panel is set up.

need_content.message: A text or a GIF is needed.
